description: DEPRECATED — each of these 15 flat seed ids is nothing more than one content skeleton crossed with one Style, under a fixed name. Prefer list_skeletons + list_styles + create_deck_from_style, which reaches all 21 curated Styles (not just the 15 pre-paired ones) and generates real imagery. The ids keep working forever via create_deck's templateId; the listing names the pair behind each.
